authority.candidateBinding: `RC` is exact final root and ten gitlinks plus Story 15.1 record/revalidation, all predecessor records/evidence and test identities.

outcome.title: Generate the superseding attestation and predecessor-supersession record
outcome.bounded: one attestation and one supersession bundle are generated; the story makes no readiness or release-closure decision.

rollback.boundary: remove only the additive v2 attestation/supersession generator/validator/bundles, faults/results and Story 15.2 record; rewrite no predecessor, signed evidence, baseline, ADR or proof.
